children: According to Wallstreetcn, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he had spoken with a representative of U.S. President Donald Trump and that from that day until Monday, September 7, Ukraine was willing to stop attacks on Moscow and hoped Russia would also stop attacks on Kyiv. He said a diplomatic event planned for September 6 in Kyiv, with a U.S. team participating, had been finalized, and that the Ukrainian side was ready for substantive talks with U.S. presidential envoy Witkoff and Kushner.

title: Zelenskyy Says Ukraine Is Ready to Halt Moscow Strikes Until Monday
